B: Inhibition of hedgehog (Hh) signaling via suppression of Smoothened (SMO) translocation and GLI1 transcriptional activity
C: Attenuation of fibroblast-to-myofibroblast transition and extracellular matrix deposition in IPF
statement: Itraconazole, an FDA-approved antifungal, could be repurposed for IPF by suppressing hedgehog pathway-driven fibroblast activation.

B: Inhibition of aldehyde dehydrogenase (ALDH) leading to accumulation of acetaldehyde and subsequent downregulation of TGF-β1-induced Smad2/3 phosphorylation
C: Reduction of collagen production and myofibroblast differentiation in pulmonary fibrosis
statement: Disulfiram, an alcohol-aversion drug, may mitigate IPF through ALDH-mediated disruption of TGF-β signaling in fibroblasts.

B: 5-lipoxygenase (5-LOX) inhibition reducing leukotriene B4 (LTB4) synthesis, thereby blocking monocyte-derived macrophage recruitment and alternative (M2) activation
C: Decreased pro-fibrotic macrophage accumulation in the IPF lung and less fibroblast activation
statement: Zileuton, an asthma drug, could limit IPF progression by blunting 5-LOX-dependent LTB4-driven recruitment of fibrosis-promoting macrophages.

B: Phosphodiesterase inhibition elevating intracellular cAMP, which enhances protein kinase A (PKA)-mediated inhibition of ERK1/2 and NF-κB pathways in epithelial cells
C: Reduction of epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) and apoptosis resistance in type II alveolar epithelial cells
statement: Pentoxifylline, a hemorheologic agent, may protect against IPF by cAMP-dependent suppression of EMT and promotion of epithelial repair.

B: Sigma-1 receptor (S1R) agonism reducing ER stress and the unfolded protein response (UPR) via IRE1α-XBP1 axis modulation in alveolar epithelial cells
C: Prevention of epithelial cell apoptosis and senescence, preserving alveolar architecture in IPF
statement: Fluvoxamine, an SSRI with potent S1R agonist activity, could be repurposed for IPF by attenuating epithelial ER stress-driven apoptosis.

B: L-type calcium channel blockade reducing mitochondrial calcium overload and inhibiting calcium-dependent activation of calcineurin/NFATc3 signaling in fibroblasts
C: Inhibition of fibroblast proliferation and matrix synthesis driven by NFATc3, a recognized pro-fibrotic transcription factor in IPF
statement: Verapamil, a calcium channel blocker, could suppress IPF fibroblast activity by preventing calcineurin/NFATc3 pathway activation.

B: Cereblon-mediated degradation of Ikaros transcription factors IKZF1/IKZF3, leading to reduced B-cell activating factor (BAFF) and aberrant B-cell responses
C: Diminishing pulmonary B-cell aggregates and autoantibody production that contribute to IPF progression
statement: Thalidomide, an immunomodulatory drug, may be effective in IPF by reducing pathogenic B-cell responses via cereblon-Ikaros axis.

B: AMPK activation leading to inhibition of mTORC1 and induction of autophagy, which clears mitochondrial reactive oxygen species (mtROS) in senescent fibroblasts
C: Elimination of senescent myofibroblasts via enhanced autophagy, reducing fibrotic niche persistence in IPF
statement: Metformin, a diabetes drug, could promote senescent cell clearance in IPF through AMPK-driven autophagy in fibrosis-associated senescent cells.

B: Angiotensin II type 1 receptor (AT1R) blockade upregulating angiotensin-converting enzyme 2 (ACE2) and angiotensin-(1-7) production, which counteracts TGF-β via Mas receptor
C: Attenuation of TGF-β-driven fibrosis through enhanced protective renin-angiotensin system (RAS) arm in IPF
statement: Candesartan, an ARB, could be repurposed for IPF by shifting RAS balance from pro-fibrotic Ang II to anti-fibrotic Ang-(1-7).

B: Phosphodiesterase-4 (PDE4) inhibition reducing cAMP hydrolysis, which suppresses NF-κB and TNF-α production while promoting IL-10 in alveolar macrophages
C: Shift of alveolar macrophage phenotype from pro-fibrotic M2 to anti-fibrotic M1/regulatory state, reducing fibroblast stimulation
statement: Roflumilast, a PDE4 inhibitor for COPD, may mitigate IPF by repolarizing alveolar macrophages toward an anti-fibrotic profile.

B: Phosphodiesterase-5 (PDE5) inhibition stabilizing cGMP, which activates protein kinase G (PKG) leading to phosphorylation and inhibition of TGF-β-activated kinase 1 (TAK1)
C: Interruption of TGF-β non-canonical signaling pathway in fibroblasts and reduced myofibroblast persistence
statement: Sildenafil, an erectile dysfunction drug, may directly inhibit fibrogenesis in IPF by cGMP/PKG-mediated blockade of TAK1, a key TGF-β effector.

B: Inhibition of colony-stimulating factor 1 receptor (CSF1R) signaling in monocytes, blocking differentiation and survival of pro-fibrotic monocyte-derived macrophages
C: Reduction of the pathogenic macrophage subset that drives progressive fibrosis, beyond its known anti-fibrotic kinase inhibition
statement: Nintedanib's CSF1R inhibition property could be leveraged as a primary mechanism to deplete pro-fibrotic monocyte-derived macrophages in IPF.

B: PPARα agonism inducing expression of fibroblast growth factor 21 (FGF21), which acts as an autocrine/paracrine factor to suppress TGF-β1-induced collagen expression
C: Attenuation of matrix production by lung fibroblasts through a novel FGF21-dependent anti-fibrotic pathway
statement: Fenofibrate, a lipid-lowering drug, could inhibit IPF fibroblast collagen synthesis by PPARα-mediated induction of FGF21.

B: Iron chelation reducing intracellular labile iron pool, thereby inhibiting iron-dependent prolyl hydroxylase domain (PHD) enzymes and stabilizing hypoxia-inducible factor (HIF)-2α, which promotes antioxidant gene expression in epithelial cells
C: Protection of alveolar epithelial cells from iron-induced oxidative damage and ferroptosis, slowing IPF progression
statement: Deferoxamine, an iron-chelator for hemochromatosis, could be repositioned for IPF by preventing ferroptosis and oxidative injury in alveolar epithelium.

B: Inhibition of microtubule polymerization suppressing NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and IL-1β release in alveolar macrophages and fibroblasts
C: Reduction of IL-1β-driven fibroblast activation and chronic inflammation that contributes to IPF progression
statement: Colchicine, a gout medication, may treat IPF by blocking NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1β production, a key pro-fibrotic cytokine.
